question: Should this PR merge without exact-head runtime proof of the isolated Cloudflare deployment job?
rationale: Generation, publication, retry behavior, artifact validation, and token cleanup are proven on the final head, but accepting an unexecuted credential-bearing deployment path requires explicit maintainer risk ownership.

options.title: Run deploy-only proof
options.body: Authorize the exact head with generation disabled and deployment enabled, then retain redacted logs showing successful checkout, Cloudflare configuration, and Pages deployment.

options.title: Waive deployment proof
options.body: Accept the moved deployment commands based on static review and existing workflow behavior while relying on the two successful publication runs.

recommendation.title: Run deploy-only proof
recommendation.body: Authorize the exact head with generation disabled and deployment enabled, then retain redacted logs showing successful checkout, Cloudflare configuration, and Pages deployment.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the workflow and the adjacent credential-isolation pattern, so he is the best-supported owner for this item-specific proof waiver.
